evaluation: Evaluate all four cells for every configuration. The research gate passes if one configuration achieves at least three cells. Report every configuration; representative selection maximizes achieved cells, then minimizes geometric mean of the four protocol/barrier medians. Fastest end-to-end configuration is reported separately.
provenance: Records the existing prompt research threshold without changing its metric, count or coverage; fixed before the corrected ablation session. The superseded partial session is excluded.
